name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Standard Terms)
description: Common Paper's standard mutual non-disclosure agreement terms, allowing two parties to exchange confidential information for a stated purpose. Used together with Mutual-NDA-coverpage.md, which incorporates these terms by reference.

name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement (Cover Page)
description: Cover page for the Common Paper Mutual NDA that captures the deal-specific variables (purpose, effective date, term, governing law) and signature block, incorporating the Mutual-NDA.md Standard Terms by reference.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering service access, restrictions, privacy and security, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for giving an early customer or partner access to a product in exchange for feedback, covering product access, the feedback program, fees, confidentiality, and intellectual property.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard SLA, designed to be used alongside the Cloud Service Agreement, defining uptime targets, response time targets, and service credit remedies for failing to meet those targets.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for procuring professional services under one or more statements of work, covering service delivery, deliverables and IP assignment, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, and insurance.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard DPA governing how a service provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including processor/subprocessor obligations, international data transfers (EEA SCCs and UK Addendum), security incident response, audits, and deletion of personal data.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for licensing on-premises or client-side software, covering the license grant, restrictions, payment, term and termination, warranties, liability, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for business partnerships involving mutual obligations, trademark licensing for co-marketing, payment terms, privacy, escalation procedures, and confidentiality.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard HIPAA business associate agreement, covering permitted uses and disclosures of protected health information (PHI), safeguards, subcontractors, breach notification, and term and termination.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Common Paper's standard agreement for a short-term trial or evaluation of a product before committing to a longer-term deal, covering pilot access, restrictions, term and termination, warranties, and liability.

name: AI Addendum
description: Common Paper's standard addendum governing use of AI features within a product, covering permitted use of AI services, restrictions, model training rights, ownership of inputs and outputs, and AI-specific disclaimers.
